Website information

Privacy

This website introduces April Johnson’s real estate services. The information below describes how the current website works.

Inquiry forms

Information entered into an inquiry form is processed in your browser. The form does not automatically send your details to April, a CRM or a database. You can choose to copy or download your inquiry, or open it in your email app to review and send.

Email and phone links

If you choose to send an email or make a call, your email or telephone provider processes that communication. Information you choose to send to April is received through that channel.

Browsing and hosting

This build does not add advertising trackers, analytics scripts or tracking cookies. The hosting provider may process technical connection information and access controls needed to serve the website. Site access may require signing in during private review.

Questions

For questions about information you have shared with April, contact aprilj@1stclassre.com.

Future connections

This notice must be reviewed when direct form submission, Lofty CRM, property-search tools or analytics are added, before those features collect visitor information.
